== Spelling: Wirfs, not Wirth or Wirs ==
'''Build notes'''
* The 2009 World Championship Day 2 sheets (2009 Worlds Day 2.pdf, pages 114–115) are handwritten "Chris Wirfs". They are filed alphabetically between Ian W. (pages 112–113) and the end of the W names. The 2008 sheets (2008 Worlds Day 2.pdf page 1, Team.pdf page 15) and the 2010 Day 2 sheet (page 119) also read "Wirfs". No source spells the name "Wirth" or "Wirs". Both were misreadings in the first transcriptions, so [[Chris Wirth]] and [[Chris Wirs]] redirect here, and the 2009 scan files were moved to the Wirfs names.
* The "Sources" list was moved into references on the matching Tournament Results rows (prose page, rule R-2026-10-20-g). The three Outrider Cup recaps that match no row are now under External links. Every cited URL has an opened Preserved copy.
* The Challonge reference now cites the tournament's /standings page, which lists his row. The main bracket page is behind a Cloudflare check that neither FlareSolverr nor Wayback could pass. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 00:38, 21 October 2026 (UTC)
